title: Sanitary Tee on Horizontal Drain Lines
description: A common mistake in waste pipe installation is using a standard sanitary tee to connect horizontal drain lines. Sanitary tees are designed primarily for transitioning from horizontal to vertical flow. When installed on horizontal runs, the short radius sweep can cause sluggish drainage, frequent clogs, and improper flow direction. Professional plumbers use a combination Wye and 1/8 bend fitting for horizontal-to-horizontal waste connections to ensure a smooth directional sweep and reduce solid waste accumulation. Always consult local plumbing codes for approved fitting orientations.
